review_method: Direct visual review of the saved PNG via authenticated filesystem bytes; native PDF page and font operators inspected without regeneration.
visual_findings: All six panels, titles, axes, units, legend and full footer are readable and unclipped.
The two columns show only set A episodes 0 and 2, selected from the prior audit as illustrative endings.
Height and pitch are explicitly pre-action states; velocity is explicitly the outgoing transition.
Final-row diamonds mark unavailable successors, and the health-terminal row retains its recorded red cost marker.
The dashed next-position velocity reconstruction stops before the final unavailable successor.
The footer distinguishes strict health bounds and the signed transition-speed rule; no unseen terminal state is drawn.

format_checks.clipping_check: Saved PNG visually checked; PDF uses the same Matplotlib figure.

scientific_limits: Explicitly selected illustrative episodes, not a prevalence estimate or preregistered selection.
A recorded health-terminal transition does not make the last saved pre-action state unhealthy.
The absent terminal successor prevents independent final-transition velocity/termination reconstruction.
report_embedding: Use full width on its own report page; 7-inch native width, 7.4-inch native height.
